Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1291
Claimant:
Jeff Taylor
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
01/06/2025
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision in which the insured vehicle was struck by another
vehicle. The claimant reports neck pain and has retained counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's office.
01/30/2025
Police report obtained. The reporting officer confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene and that the
vehicles came to rest in the positions described.
02/07/2025
Photographs of the damage received from the insured. The front-end damage on the vehicle is consistent with the
reported impact and the reported speed.
02/11/2025
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was active on the loss date. Nothing in the file points to
damage existing before the policy period began.
02/21/2025
Vehicle history checked. No prior damage claims or repair records are on file for this vehicle.
02/23/2025
Attorney letter received with medical authorization. Claimant's initial treatment began within a day of the collision and
followed a typical course of evaluation, imaging, and physical therapy.
04/15/2025
Prior records requested. The claimant had a minor strain in the same area of the neck several years ago, which
resolved fully with treatment. The reported injury pattern fits the force of this collision.
05/07/2025
Recorded statement from the claimant obtained through counsel. The claimant added a few small details about the
momnets after impact, but the core acocunt matches the original report.
05/19/2025
No independent witnesses have come forward. The photographs confirm several details of the scene but do not show
the collision itself.
06/19/2025
Treatment notes reviewed. Therapy visits tapered off as the claimant's symptoms improved, and the treating
provider's notes describe steady recovery.
07/31/2025
File reviewed for handling. Liability and injury evaluation are proceeding on the current documentation, with a
settlement discussion to follow once the final treatment summary is received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
